# FLX-6105: a first name that is a root and also a column or relationship

**Family:** expression language (the 6000 band)

In a FLUX-side text, row, link, previous and CHILDREN are roots. When the expose also has a column or relationship of that name, say which one you mean: `row.<name>` for the column, `link.<name>` for the relationship. A PARTITION BY relationship whose name is also a column is written `link.<name>`.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-6105
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
